items.en_title: Boston Chinatown first-come closes Mar 3, 2027: 3 below-market homes downtown
items.en_oneliner: A first-come opening in Boston's Chinatown closes Mar 3, 2027 with 3 homes; below-market homes downtown are rare, and with a distant deadline there is time to prepare a strong application.
